top_signals.title: Japan ‘months’ from running out of critical rare earth as China squeezes supply
top_signals.summary: Tokyo asks US to help convince Beijing to ease chokehold on yttrium and avert manufacturing shutdown
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Corn Faces Longest Losing Streak Since Early 2025 on Weak Demand
top_signals.summary: US corn futures fell for a sixth day, their longest losing streak since March 2025, as harvest pressure and weak exports led hedge funds to sell their positions at a rapid pace.
